claim_boundary: Transfer and proposal learning are independent software sensitivity evidence over simulator sweeps; they are not hardware, silicon, measured energy, or production evidence.

base_ledger.claim_boundary: Typed policy ledger contains simulation evidence and declared cost proxies only; it is not a hardware measurement record.

derived_ledger.claim_boundary: Content-hashed derived simulator ledger; the parent ledger is preserved and no hardware or production claim is made.

fresh_trials.claim_boundary: Fresh simulator trials generated from a learned-search proposal; separate from the frozen ledger and not hardware, silicon, or production evidence.
